# llmdojo


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

llmdojo is retired. Its commands have moved:

- `claudedojo -c` and `codexdojo -c` are now `claudecompact` and `codexcompact` in [llmsurgery](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/llmsurgery). Their standing arguments moved from `~/.config/claudedojo/config.toml` to `~/.config/llmsurgery/config.toml`.
- `claudesub` is now in [aai-coding](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/aai-coding).
